system.description:
Lore: Relic Wand (Bound)

A slender rod of blackened ash, warm to the touch when a spell is on the wielder's lips. It has the following Powers:

  • (+1) Trinket: Deals an extra +1 Spell damage, and the wielder ignores half-Cover when Casting.

Value: 200g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
